headline: Illumia Appoints Eric Schuster as Chief Product Officer
summary: SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., July 30, 2026--Illumia, a leading provider of technology solutions that power payments, identity, commerce, and foodservice operations across higher education, healthcare, and corporate campuses, today named Eric Schuster as Chief Product Officer.

headline: Roper Technologies (NASDAQ:ROP) Passes Quality Investing Screen with Robust Profitability and Cash Generation
summary: Roper Technologies passes the Caviar Cruise quality screen with strong revenue and profit growth, high ROIC, and cash conversion, though liquidity ratios are weak.
